newsitem.title: USA: Premiere Techs to acquire Voice-Tel.
newsitem.headline: Premiere Techs to acquire Voice-Tel.

text.p: Premiere Technologies Inc said Wednesday it has signed definitive agreements to acquire Voice-Tel Enterprises in a deal valued at $185 million.
Premiere did not disclose terms of what it said was a primarily stock transaction. It said, however, that the deal included certainly independently operated franchises.
It said the deal will be accounted for primarily as a pooling of interests. It said it expects the transaction to be completed in the second quarter of 1997, subject to various closing conditions.
Voice-Tel manages private digital voice and data messaging network.

Premiere said the acquisition will allow it to deliver a comprehensive, integrated suite of personal communication services accessible through personal computer, toll-free 800 lines and local seven-digit phone numbers.
It added that the revenues of Voice-Tel will double its size.

Premiere integrates information and telecommunication services in network-based platforms. It offers its services and customized data to users in over 100 countries under the names Premiere Worldlink and Orchestrate.
